about: A paper that argues for one thesis by analysing what earlier sources did (decisions, trials, studies). Facts are holdings: subject --relation--> source; entity numbers (awards, hearing days) are made by code and checked by PaperOrchestra (row ids).

Defend the thesis; then state the strongest counter-argument and answer it from the {FACTS}.
